_comment: Battle AI phase 1 (#584) showcase: three unit-leader decisions issued as real queue orders, with no direct target_enemy write. (1) The AI spearmen (anti_cavalry) on the left forms the anti-cavalry square on its own as player cavalry closes -- no player key press arms it, unlike the player-driven anti-cav-square.json demo. (2) The AI infantry on the right advances and attacks the player infantry it's assigned (the advance/attack fallback, now a real ATTACK order) while a second player unit is walked onto its flank; the AI leader reacts by re-facing onto the flanker. Deterministic (scenario + seed + scripted input). The map keeps the default forest but leaves off the hill: the second player Cavalry troop is staged where the hill's south-west corner stands, and the clip is about AI decisions, not terrain.

overlap.reason: uid 1 (team 1's 140-strong spearmen block) is mid-transit through a SECOND forced re-slot for the whole catalog-cadence sampling window. The AI's ATTACK order re-targets from enemy uid 0 to uid 2 between the tick 300 and tick 330 samples (target_enemy_uid flips, facing swings from ~[0.97,-0.08] toward [-0.55,0.83] and back), and that order re-stamp calls Unit.start_order_response() -> reform_ranks(), which re-arms the standoff settle window (Unit._standoff_settle_until_tick, read by SoldierBodies, #1537) and re-slots the entire block onto a freshly-rotated grid before the FIRST reform (from the tick~150 in-place REFORM phase while the order was still MOVE; the MOVE->ATTACK order change itself lands between ticks 240 and 250) has even finished converging (own_slot_dist_med was down to ~7.9 wu at the tick 300 sample; a dense local dump, every 10 ticks, puts the jump back to ~78.5 wu at tick 310, and the tick 330 sample already shows the re-rotated grid). A 140-body block takes several hundred ticks to walk back onto a fully-rotated grid, and while it does, files legitimately cross each other, so SoldierBodies' nearest-neighbour distance dips under the foot floor mid-crossing (measured worst 1.755 wu against the 2.25 wu floor at ~tick 420, on current main after #1538's derate) even though the standoff pass is doing its job of policing that crossing, not causing it. Measured 2026-09-08 at the website catalog cadence (issue #1544). Uid 3, overlap: Dense 2-tick FULL dumps, every exemption removed, Windows, seeds 0 to 4: 9f9bddee reads pass, pass, pass, pass, pass; ea0a9029 (#1880) reads pass, pass, 4.77, pass, pass, against 5.0. Not traced; the battle runs on a different trajectory from 9f9bddee's, and men of one block crossing while they re-form is the likely mechanism (#1791). Measured 2026-10-31.

shape_residual.reason: uid 1: same re-slot-before-settling mechanism as the overlap exemption above: uid 1's grid is still walking onto its second, freshly-rotated set of target slots at every sample tick from 330 through the end of the clip, so the best-fit rigid-transform residual against the (already-superseded) prior orientation stays large the whole time (measured worst 29.26 wu against the 6.75 wu threshold, at ~tick 420). It is genuinely converging (in a dense local dump, own_slot_dist_med falls from ~78.5 wu at tick 310 to ~0.38 wu by tick 720; the sampled ticks show the same descent), just too slowly for a 140-man block to settle within this clip's length once the AI's mid-march re-target restarted the reform. Measured 2026-09-08 (issue #1544). uid 3 (team 0's second cavalry block, 60 horses, frontage 8): the drift out of its grid while it manoeuvres, tracked in #1716, from about tick 450 on both sides. A rigid best fit of its bodies to its slots gives a median residual, at ticks 460/500/540/600/700, of 10/25/53/106/212 wu on the merge-base and 8/13/28/57/112 wu here. On the merge-base every sample from tick 440 on (141 of 141 at 2-tick spacing) is in enemy contact, which the scan does not judge, so it reads 4.198. Here 18 of 123 are not, the troop marching between charges, and the scan judges those: single samples read 31.2 at tick 540, 36.5 at 552, 53.4 at 588 and 76.7 at 636, following the same ramp, and the dense 2-tick defect delta against 86fd0902 (#1774) reads a worst of 76.23 against the 30 wu threshold. uid 3 never turns or re-squares on either side: at every 2-tick sample its order is ATTACK or none, its phase NONE or none, its formation NORMAL and its frontage 8. The clip diverges at tick 31, 0.02 wu inside uid 1's quarter-turn, and the melee amplifies that. Measured 2026-10-10. uid 2: a block whose grid is scrambled in melee is judged the moment it is briefly out of contact (#1837). With the interior strike (#1834) its fight lets go of it for a few ticks at a time between bouts (on the clip seed out of contact at t378 to t402, t406 to t414 and t418 to t420, then t500 to t582), and it is judged there. Worst, clip seed and seeds 1 to 4: head 40.9, pass, pass, pass, 64.2 against 13.5; main pass, pass, 37.5, pass, pass. Measured 2026-10-22 on dense 2-tick dumps of the clip seed and perturbed seeds 1 to 4 (SPARTA_DEMO_SEED_RUN), main 82991008 against the #1834 head d067d21a, judged with no exemption. The gating scan at this script's declared state ticks (FULL dump, all exemptions removed, the d77a9a67 tree with sim = d067d21a, Windows) passes this uid; the exemption covers the dense 2-tick delta, where the head fails more seed runs than main. Re-measured for #1852 (2026-10-23, Windows, dense 2-tick FULL dumps of the clip seed and seeds 1 to 4, all exemptions removed, worst judged shape_residual against 13.5): uid 2 reads 87.04, pass, 87.00, pass, pass at sim commits e55342c1 and b236be47 (two distinct readings on seeds 0 and 2, not a copied value) and 40.89, pass, pass, pass, 64.22 on main 799b0bca: this PR fails as many seeds as main, but it worsens uid 2's worst value, 87.04 against main's 64.22. uid 4 (team 1's 120-man foot block): its grid is scrambled in the opening melee (#1837). An order re-issued mid-fight keeps its fold (#1852), so its trajectory differs from main's from tick 373, and on seed 3 it is judged out of contact on that scrambled grid: worst 35.13 at e55342c1 and 35.12 at b236be47 on seed 3 and 10.57 (pass) on the other four; main reads 10.57 (pass) on all five. Uid 3, re-measured for #1880: dense 2-tick FULL dumps, every exemption removed, Windows, seeds 0 to 4: 9f9bddee reads pass, pass, pass, pass, pass; ea0a9029 reads pass, pass, 150.40, pass, pass; 246fc3b3 read 190.66, pass, pass, 39.86, pass, against 30.0. The troop's fitted residual (the drift of #1716: every man more than 9 wu off his slot from about tick 410 on both trees) is higher with this change, not only judged at another moment. At ticks 540 / 636 / 720, 9f9bddee against ea0a9029: seed 0 41.0 / 129.6 / 211.1 against 53.9 / 143.9 / 222.9; seed 1 39.3 / 124.2 / 206.4 against 53.4 / 140.2 / 220.5; seed 2 41.0 / 130.3 / 212.1 against 53.3 / 133.0 / 193.7; seed 3 12.7 / 30.4 / 54.0 against 53.2 / 139.1 / 217.7; seed 4 40.4 / 128.1 / 208.6 against 57.3 / 140.3 / 219.1. ea0a9029 is higher at tick 540 on all five seeds (by 12.4 to 16.9 wu, and by 40.5 on seed 3, where 9f9bddee's troop takes a slower ramp), at tick 636 on all five, and at tick 720 on four (seed 2 is 18.4 lower). Traced cause: the troop never takes the share of the march's acceleration itself (an instrumented run logs none of its steps on any of seeds 0 to 4; it fights on ATTACK orders). The share goes to uid 1 (the AI's move orders, from about tick 48 to 420) and uid 4 (about ticks 50 to 182), it changes their marches, and the fight the troop is in runs differently. Switching one mechanism off at a time on the clip seed (ticks 540 / 636 / 720): share off 40.4 / 128.2 / 207.9, which is 9f9bddee's ramp; blend off 53.2 / 132.2 / 209.5; stop grace off 53.9 / 141.2 / 219.4; all three off reproduces 9f9bddee exactly. The size of the ramp follows the course of that fight, not the amount of share: the share off for uid 1 alone gives 17.1 / 78.2 / 157.1, and for uid 4 alone 12.8 / 31.1 / 55.5, both far below either tree. So no sim change aimed at the troop applies: the share acts as intended on other blocks' orderly marches, and the drift is #1716's. Which seeds fail is then set by when the troop is out of contact: 9f9bddee is in contact at every sample from tick 440 on seeds 0, 1, 2 and 4, and on seed 3 is judged only up to 17.6 wu; ea0a9029 is judged on seed 2 alone, from tick 584 to 658, reading 90.5 to 150.4. On 246fc3b3 the clip seed was judged from tick 636 to 704, 137.6 to 190.66, and seed 3 at ticks 524 to 550 and 668 to 670, up to 39.86; 86fd0902's 76.23 came from a single sample at tick 636. At the 60 Hz body step the sim is ea0a9029's at every later commit of #1880: every 2-tick sample of the seed-0 catalog, the march_start_catch_up clip included, is hash-identical between ea0a9029 and af0393b7 on the same inputs. Later commits count the march's stop grace in body steps (2) where ea0a9029 timed it (2.5 / 60 s), which agree only at that step rate. Tracked in #1716. Measured 2026-10-31. Uid 2, re-measured for #1880: dense 2-tick FULL dumps, every exemption removed, Windows, seeds 0 to 4: 9f9bddee reads pass, pass, pass, pass, pass; ea0a9029 reads pass, pass, pass, 79.15, pass, against 13.5. Not traced; the battle runs on a different trajectory from 9f9bddee's, and this is a block scrambled by a melee and judged out of contact (#1837). Measured 2026-10-31.
